import pytest

from f049 import modp


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "p", "expected"),
    [
        (0, 1000, 1),          # loop body never runs
        (1, 1000, 2),          # single iteration
        (10, 1000, 24),        # 1024 % 1000
        (10, 1024, 0),         # exact multiple of p
        (0, 1, 1),             # modulo 1, no iterations
        (5, 1, 0),             # modulo 1 after iterations -> 0
        (3, 13, 8),            # 8 % 13
        (100, 97, pow(2, 100, 97)),
    ],
)
def test_modp_matches_pow(n, p, expected):
    result = modp(n, p)
    assert result == expected
    assert result == pow(2, n, p)
    assert 0 <= result < p


def test_modp_zero_exponent_returns_one_without_looping(monkeypatch):
    """n == 0 must skip the loop body entirely (covers the no-iteration branch)."""
    calls = []

    real_range = range

    def spy_range(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(args)
        return real_range(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.range", spy_range)
    assert modp(0, 7) == 1
    assert calls == [(0,)]


def test_modp_loops_n_times(monkeypatch):
    """n > 0 must run the loop body exactly n times."""
    calls = []

    real_range = range

    def spy_range(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(args)
        return real_range(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr("builtins.range", spy_range)
    assert modp(4, 100) == 16
    assert calls == [(4,)]


def test_modp_does_not_mutate_inputs_semantics():
    n, p = 7, 5
    assert modp(n, p) == 3
    assert modp(n, p) == modp(n, p)  # deterministic / no hidden state
    assert (n, p) == (7, 5)
```
